compose_graphs: compose two weighted finite state transducer graphs using gtn.compose to chain input and output symbols
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a graph using gtn.forward_score for log-sum-exp over all paths
find_viterbi_path: find the highest scoring path through a graph using gtn.viterbi_path and gtn.viterbi_score
concatenate_graphs: concatenate multiple graphs in sequence using gtn.concat to chain transducer languages together
remove_epsilon_arcs: remove epsilon transitions from a graph using gtn.remove to eliminate empty symbol arcs
